school: Department of Information Systems, Business Statistics and Operations Management (ISOM), School of Business and Management

university_graduation_requirements.note: Generic university-wide figure carried over from the existing COMP entry in programs.json; not independently re-verified against a BBA-IS-specific page during this transcription.

requirement_groups.notes: ISOM 3210 (Information Systems Analysis and Design, 3cr) and ISOM 3260 (Database Design and Administration, 4cr) are both required. ISOM 3320 (Business Applications Development in Java) OR ISOM 3400 (Business Applications Development in Python), 3cr, is chosen based on which intro programming course (COMP 1022P vs COMP 1021) the student took.

This option is defined under the IEDA/IEEM program page but explicitly lists ISOM 4530 as an eligible elective; included here for completeness since it touches ISOM course offerings. Optional add-on, CGA >= 3.0 required to enroll. Not part of the core BBA-IS major requirement.

notes: The 'Elective(s)' group (IS Electives: at least 3 ISOM courses totaling 10 credits, coded 3000-3499 or 4000-4499) is a rule-based range requirement, not a closed list of course codes -- the official PDF gives no enumerated list, so it was intentionally NOT written as a requirement_group. See manual_isom_ieda_notes.md for detail. total_credits_required and university_graduation_requirements are the generic university-wide baseline (same as other majors in programs.json), not confirmed on a BBA-IS-specific page.

name: Bachelor of Engineering in Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management (BEng in IEEM)
school: Department of Industrial Engineering and Decision Analytics (IEDA), School of Engineering

university_graduation_requirements.note: Generic university-wide figure carried over from the existing COMP entry in programs.json; not independently re-verified against an IEEM-specific page during this transcription.

requirement_groups.notes: Sub-notes: [COMP 1023 OR COMP 2011 OR COMP 2012H, 3-5cr]; [CHEM 1012 OR PHYS 1112 OR PHYS 1312, 3cr]; [(MATH 1013 OR MATH 1023) AND (MATH 1014 OR MATH 1024)] OR [MATH 1020], 4-6cr; plus MATH 2011 and MATH 2111 both required outright.

IEDA 1010/1020/1901 are 0-credit. IEDA 4901 (Final Year Thesis) OR IEDA 4960 (IEEM Final Year Project), 6cr -- students in the Research Option must take IEDA 4901. ECON 2103 OR ECON 2113 (Microeconomics), 3cr.

'Industrial Engineering Electives, courses from the specified elective list', minimum 21 credits. IEDA 4000 (Special Topics) is 1-3cr (used 1 for the estimated sum, i.e. lower bound); all others are 3cr. Unlike the 2019-20 curriculum this list no longer splits into Engineering Management / Logistics Management / Other groups with a 15+6 credit split -- the 2025-26 cohort version is a single flat elective list.
Optional add-on; requires CGA >= 3.0 to apply for enrollment. Not part of the core IEEM major requirement.
2 courses from the specified list, min 6 credits. ISOM 4530 is 4cr, the others are 3cr each.

IEEM Advanced Electives: 2 courses from the specified list (advisor approval required). Students in the Research Option must also take IEDA 4901 (already listed under core Required Course(s)). Note the 2019-20 curriculum additionally listed IEDA 5260, which no longer appears on the 2025-26 cohort PDF -- possibly discontinued or renumbered; not re-verified.

notes: total_credits_required and university_graduation_requirements are the generic university-wide baseline (same as other majors in programs.json), not confirmed on an IEEM-specific page. The PDF program title uses 'IEEM' (Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management) even though the owning department is now named IEDA (Industrial Engineering and Decision Analytics) -- HKUST also separately offers a newer 'BEng in Decision Analytics' program under the same department, which was NOT transcribed here (out of scope for this task).
